name: Worldpay

google.heading: Worldpay on Google
google.summary: Only 13 reviews on the Cincinnati listing, which is far too few to be a rating, and the listing is unclaimed. It is included because of what the 9 one-star reviews are about, which is the same thing in three different industries. A nonprofit that held its annual event and had received nothing a week later. A small business with over 45,000 dollars held after a single transaction was queried. A medical practice owed more than 15,000 dollars in insurance payments after completing and notarising everything asked of it. Three accounts, one complaint: money taken in and not passed on, with the merchant chasing. Read this as three data points rather than as a score, and weigh it against the fact that Worldpay processes for a very large number of businesses who have never written anything anywhere.

themes.label: Settlement, not service
themes.detail: All three detailed complaints are about funds taken in and not passed on, rather than about fees, hardware or support manner.

themes.label: Thirteen reviews
themes.detail: Too small to average. The value here is the consistency of the three long accounts, not the 2.2.

quotes.text: The WORST merchant account EVER! We have to fight to get paid. We had our annual event a week ago and have not received ONE DIME from WorldPay since our event.
Worldpay is holding $45,000 of my business funds and this has been the worst processor experience I've ever had.

noRedditReason: Worldpay barely registers on Reddit. The searches return an SEC filing summary about Global Payments acquiring it and one NetSuite thread where it is a name on a shortlist. Nothing from a merchant using it.
